column3: vix   — read as a step function: the row at-or-before the virtual clock wins

column1: # Tuned to walk an Iron Condor (PE short ~23650) to a clean
#   spot stays well above the T1 WATCH level (short+150 = 23800) for the first sessions -> HOLD
#   then on 13 Jul it breaches the 23650 PE short in one decisive drop (to 23500) ->
#   T3_SHORT_STRIKE_BREACH -> EXIT. The drop skips the WATCH/READJUST bands in a single tick so the
#   auto-conductor doesn't readjust-and-reenter before the exit (which would muddy the result).
# VIX rises 18 -> 22.5 but stays < 24 (no PAUSE) with small intraday steps (no >30% spike override)
# so the EXIT is unambiguously the price breach
